question: Which seed-letter constitutes the essential nature of Dhūmāvatī?
premises: Dhūmāvatī is described as having an essence.
Her essence is identified with the letter thakāra.
inference: Dhūmāvatī is worshipped as whose very essence is the letter thakāra.
plain_english: I worship Dhūmāvatī, whose entire essence is the letter thakāra.
